limits: Chromium preflight execution does not qualify physical browser/GPU profiles or close W24.
Regional examples use bounded offline data while retaining computational/rendering stages, rather than reproducing publication datasets.
Native definition routes identify relevant current capability tests, not execution of every historical Python assertion.
Pro examples require a normal valid key; browser tests use an isolated test issuer.

checkoutByteIntegrity.method: Compared raw bytes with Git blob identities for all native-byte-preserved assets and both converted PNG copies; .gitattributes prevents checkout conversion.
